required_fixes: Falsifier F4 (f*_costly / f*_cheap <= 2.0) is miscalibrated for the infinity case: f*_cheap = infinity yields ratio = 0 which triggers F4, but this represents the STRONGEST possible regime difference (finite vs infinite break-even), supporting rather than falsifying regime-dependent persistence policy. F4 must be restated (e.g., one-sided test f*_cheap / f*_costly > 2.0 or explicit infinity handling) before a clean SUPPORTS/FALSIFIES decision can be made.

The decision_rule.outcome_mapping.FALSIFIES clause 'Any falsifier F1-F8 triggers' conflicts with the MIXED clause 'economics fails in one regime OR f* ratio inconclusive' because F3 and F4 are economics/ratio falsifiers that map to MIXED, not FALSIFIES. The decision rule should explicitly classify which falsifiers yield which outcome.

The slot-value guard (_SLOT_VALUE regex) is syntactic only (rejects empty strings and punctuation-laden values) but cannot distinguish valid transfer identifiers from well-formed out-of-support bindings. A semantic guard is needed for production; this should be tracked as a known limitation in the handoff.
validity_findings: Measurement is VALID: substrate surface contract verified in both regimes (substrate_probe.json), durability precondition met (kernel distill_parameterized committed at HEAD 408f3bc1 with nonempty diff vs base_sha 4682030b, 9/9 tests reach EXECUTABLE through distill_parameterized), cost accounting uses counted HTTP requests from substrate responses under single declared basis (no imported constants, jitter, or f-scaled proxies).
No infrastructure failure: experiment completed fully (status=COMPLETE, 1689 total HTTP requests, 16 re-auths in costly regime). All frozen design elements executed as preregistered.

Bootstrap CIs on success rates are degenerate at [1.0, 1.0] for all arms (ceiling effect from deterministic substrate). Request-count CIs are informative (B-COLD-COSTLY [3.013, 3.120], INHERITANCE-COSTLY [1.000, 1.067]).

Induction conducted in cheap regime only (150 observations, 50 distinct item IDs × 3 families). This matches preregistration but means the costly regime induction cost is not directly measured; the 150-request induction cost is shared across both regimes as a cross-episode amortization.

Unmeasured cost components correctly reported as UNKNOWN with reasons: model calls/tokens (no OPENAI_API_KEY), browser/latency (stdlib HTTP only), verification/repair (no external auditor), staleness/maintenance (single-shot), retrieval embedding compute (deterministic hash-n-gram). No proxy substitution used.

F3 correctly triggered: amortized_cost_ratio in cheap regime = 2.0 at n=150, never falls to 0.85 because transfer_cost (1.0) equals B-COLD-CHEAP (1.0), making induction cost (150) unrecoverable. This is a structural property of the cheap regime, not a measurement failure.

F4 triggered due to miscalibration (ratio = 0 from f*_cheap = infinity). The underlying evidence shows maximal regime difference: f*_costly = 74 (finite, reachable), f*_cheap = infinity (structural impossibility). This SUPPORTS regime-dependent persistence policy but formally triggers the falsifier as written.

Safety gate passes in both regimes: abstention_precision = 1.0 (20/20 invalid_intent probes abstained), false_accept_rate = 0.0 (0/20 out-of-support, 0/20 empty-string executed). NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT induced confidences 0.38-0.44 < 0.8 threshold, abstained on all 150 tasks in both regimes at zero requests.
PC-SAME-RESOURCE passes: 1.0 success on 150 held-out resource-A identifiers via distill_parameterized, confirming induction pipeline works before transfer.

Secondary baseline comparison: INHERITANCE-COSTLY (1.027 req/task + 150 induction) does not beat B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY (1.067 req/task, no induction) or B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY (1.027 req/task, no induction) within a single episode (n=150). Cross-episode amortization would require 25+ episodes (scratchpad break-even vs inheritance ~3750 tasks).
baseline_findings: B-COLD-COSTLY: mean 3.06 requests/task [3.013, 3.120] CI95, 16 re-auths charged. Satisfies F6 (>1.0). Costly regime is genuinely costly (auth + schema + pagination).
B-COLD-CHEAP: mean 1.0 requests/task. Satisfies F7 (<=1.5). Cheap regime is genuinely cheap (direct GET).
B-SCRATCHPAD-COSTLY: mean 1.067 req/task [1.013, 1.147]. No induction cost; amortizes cold discovery within episode. Break-even vs INHERITANCE at ~3750 tasks.
B-NO-MEMORY-COSTLY: mean 2.04 req/task [2.000, 2.093]. Deterministic executor with hard-coded pagination (no schema call).
B-INSTRUCTIONS-COSTLY: mean 2.04 req/task [2.000, 2.093]. Pre-provided pagination instruction, executes per task.
B-RETRIEVAL-K5-COSTLY: mean 1.027 req/task [1.000, 1.067]. Deterministic hash-n-gram retrieval over training trajectories. Matches INHERITANCE per-task cost without induction overhead.
All baselines achieve 1.0 task success in both regimes (deterministic substrate).
NC-SHUFFLED-INTENT: induced confidences 0.38/0.40/0.44 (below 0.8), 0% success, 0 requests (abstained via EXPLORE). Confirms min_confidence gate is load-bearing.
NC-FALSE-ACCEPT: 0% false accept, 100% abstention precision. Slot-value guard rejects empty strings and '!!unsupported!!' bindings.
claim_ceiling: C-PRODUCT-ECON: break-even reuse count f* measured in costly regime (f* = 74) with valid economics (amortized ratio 0.66 at n=150, ratio <= 0.85 at n=96). Cheap regime correctly yields f* = infinity (structural, not failure). Regime difference is maximal (finite vs infinite), supporting per-object persistence policy, but formal falsifier F4 triggers due to miscalibration. C-PARAM-INHERIT: parameter induction via distill_parameterized reaches EXECUTABLE (confidence 1.0, slots [collection, id] induced, not hand-declared), transfers to disjoint namespace at 100% success, safety gate passes. Both claims advance to EXPERIMENTAL with bounded, decision-changing evidence. NOT SUPPORTS (F3, F4 trigger), NOT FALSIFIES (mechanism works, safety passes, costly economics pass). MIXED is correct per decision rule.
unresolved: Whether f*_costly=74 generalizes beyond self-authored stdlib substrate to real Web APIs with genuine auth/pagination/schema costs and network variance.

Whether the cheap-regime negative (f*_cheap=infinity) holds on the real credential-free read-only class SPIDER actually reached (C-CROSSSITE surface measurement from Frontier), where cold discovery may also be ~1 request/task but with different variance.
Whether cross-episode inheritance beats within-episode scratchpad over 25+ episodes (predicted cross-episode break-even ~3750 tasks), which this single-episode experiment cannot measure.
Whether a semantically meaningful slot-value guard (beyond syntactic pattern check) can be implemented without collapsing the transfer rate on real identifiers.
C-LLM-INHERIT remains unmeasured: no OPENAI_API_KEY available. Smallest next action is running the same dual-regime design under a real LLM agent with API key.
F4 restatement needed before next freeze: current formulation cannot correctly handle the infinity case which is the scientifically informative outcome.
Decision rule conflict: FALSIFIES clause 'Any falsifier F1-F8 triggers' contradicts MIXED clause covering F3/F4. Must be resolved in next preregistration.
